questions.q: What is the primary function of chlorophyll in green plants?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll traps light energy needed to drive the chemical reaction of photosynthesis.

questions.q: Which gas is evolved as a byproduct during photosynthesis?
questions.explanation: Oxygen is released when water molecules are split during light reactions.

questions.q: In which cellular organelle does aerobic respiration take place?
questions.explanation: Mitochondria are known as the powerhouses of the cell where aerobic respiration occurs.

questions.q: What is the first step in cellular respiration called where glucose is broken down into pyruvate?
questions.explanation: Glycolysis takes place in the cytoplasm and breaks down 1 glucose molecule into 2 pyruvate molecules.

questions.q: During anaerobic respiration in human muscle cells, pyruvate is converted into which compound?
questions.explanation: Lack of oxygen during heavy exercise leads to lactic acid build-up in muscles.
